column1: # FogOfWar batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Two corner boolean grids over (width+1)*(height+1): field a is EXPLORATION (has the tile
# ever been seen) and field b is FOG (is it visible right now). The a(x,y)/b(x,y) tile queries
# OR the four surrounding corners, the c/d pairs address one corner, and a(boolean)/b(boolean)
# fill the whole grid. Evidence: Player.isExplorationEnabled feeds fogOfWar.a(...) and
# isFogEnabled feeds fogOfWar.b(...) in World.setupPlayers; AIContext uses a(Unit) to keep
# only seen enemies; a(Unit) itself is c(unit) && (immobile || d(unit)), i.e. an explored
# building stays visible while a mobile unit must be in range.
